details:
Having created several new instances already I have to say the new create instance UI is, well, terrible. It's a great example of the traditional engineer UI.

1. Contrast is bad. This isn't an assistance thing, it's a help the brain recognize where the divisions are. The existing menus have good contrast making the buttons obvious. The new one, the difference is much less distinct meaning it's slower to scan.

2. General clutter (with two possible ideas, but there are others.

"Who's hosting" and "Who can join" are tied together in an unexpected way - you need to change who's hosting to change the "Who can join" to group.

3. "Category" / "What's it about" / "What's the vibe" are all conveying a very similar concept - the social content of the instance.

  - Category is the very approximate grouping

  - What's the vibe is a more specific, but still select from a list

  - What's it about is a highly detailed version.

So we're providing the same information in three different ways from very rough to very fine. There is some use here, but the way it's presented is clutter, and Vibe is functionally a sub category (from a user pov), so having vibe immediately after "Category" would make sense

I'd be inclined to:

Move "Vibe" immediately after "Category", and change it to a single line (Though this is different from anywhere else on this page). I'd do the same thing to language and put it on a single line as well:

```

Category:

   CatA   CatB   CatC ...

Vibe: Vibe1   Vibe2   Add+

Language: Any 

```

I'd move "What's it about" to "Advanced Options" and default it to blank. There's no reason to repeat the world description which is already visible on the instance page (are you planning on removing it?)

4. "Drop Portal" and "Create & Join" *feel* reversed. This may just be due to knowing the locations before, but I think swapping would be good. Already a canny on this one: https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1948-please-swap-the-positions-of-the-join-and-place-portal-buttons "Drop Portal" and "Create & Join" have more visual contrast, than anything else on the page, but "Drop Portal" could still have a little more.

5. Having to scroll is a poor experience, though even with condensing it that may not be possible to avoid. But condensing it would help.

Now, for #2 I have two potential ideas and putting them down here for the tl;dr aspect. I also realize these are not the only solutions:

2a. Adjust the display such that "Who can join" is visually dependent on "Who's hosting". Perhaps put the two in a box and indent the "Who can join", which then shows they're tied together.

2b. Remove "Who's hosting", add "Group ▲" (expand arrow) to "Who can join", where it then brings up the Select group -> Instance type (the new group type menu is fine here). In this situation, once a group is selected we could add the following to the "Who can join" menu:

```

Public

Friends+

Friends

Group ▼

    My Group

        Group / Group+ / Group Public / [Role]

Invite+

Invite

```

With this, selecting "My Group" would let you change the group and perms, and the "Group / Group+ / Group Public / [Role]" line would let you keep the group but change the perms.
title: [1948] New world creation UI is cluttered
